newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Poh Lian hits high of S$0.58 on debut.
newsitem.headline: Poh Lian hits high of S$0.58 on debut.

text.p: Poh Lian Holdings shares hit a high of Singapore $0.58 on Thursday on its debut on the Stock Exchange of Singapore, a 38 percent premium on its initial public offer price of S$0.42 per share.
In the opening 20 minutes of trade, 11.5 million Poh Lian shares changed hands with the price settling back to S$0.54 from the initial S$0.58 high.
The 40.5 million Poh Lian shares made available to the public in its IPO offer was 33 times subscribed.
The flotation is expected to raise about S$21 million.

Poh Lian said the funds would be used to invest in two regional joint ventures, to expand its access equipment range and invest in new machinery, with the balance used to repay bank borrowings and increase working capital.
